reviews.text:
My pet had lost weight due to a loss of appetite, so I called to make an appointment for a first consultation, and they kindly accepted.

The atmosphere in the clinic was good, and the doctor and nurses handled my pet with great care.

They listened carefully to what I had to say and answered all my questions thoroughly.

Their kind and attentive treatment of me and my pet left a very positive impression!

The initial consultation fee is a little on the expensive side at 1500 yen, but considering the way the doctors and staff treat animals, I think it's reasonable.

*It's easy to confuse this clinic with NPBC (Namba Pet Grooming Academy) located next door.

Incidentally, I also called Naniwa Animal Clinic before calling here, but they're not the place to go.

While we sometimes go to specialist hospitals for major treatments and specialized procedures, we are extremely grateful for the care we receive here for IVs, injections, and routine checkups between treatments.

We live with many cats, and due to time and circumstances, we sometimes visit multiple hospitals. However, this hospital is considerate not only of the cats but also of the owner's needs, and yet it's not overly formal, so we feel comfortable bringing our cats here.

Previously, after a specialized surgery at another hospital, we were left with many unsettling experiences. With a long holiday approaching, transferring hospitals was difficult, and we were at a loss as our cat grew weaker day by day. However, the doctor's advice not only saved our cat but also eased our own anxieties. Many of the other pet owners who visit this hospital are also very kind.

Furthermore, we are incredibly grateful for the care you provided to save our cat who was in critical condition due to pneumonia.
The examination was gentle and thorough. The doctor and nurses were very conscientious. The consultation fee was also very reasonable. I highly recommend this veterinary hospital.
It's been over 10 years since all our cats started receiving care here. Dr. Suzaki is precise and provides excellent follow-up! The receptionists are all beautiful and kind! Everyone is reliable!

Dr. Tsuruta is kind, speaks in a gentle, almost effeminate manner, and is very caring. My previous dog was saved by Dr. Tsuruta's surgery 😭
Dr. Tsuruta, please come back 😭 The other doctors and front desk staff are all kind as well. It's a very good hospital. We've been going there for our previous dog for a long time. Thank you very much.

Although he has since moved, Dr. Tsuruta was a godsend for animals. There are very few veterinarians who are so caring and dedicated to the well-being of animals. He was one of a kind. I am truly, truly grateful. Thank you so much.

I don't know if she's a receptionist or a nurse, but there's one person with a terrible attitude. The other nurses are incredibly kind, and I think this hospital would be great if that one person just disappeared. If she doesn't want to talk to people, she should find a job that doesn't involve that.
